Victory

The Reading

Three cards wait upon the cloth. Choose one: upright it blesses the next three battles, reversed (three times in ten) it curses them.

The World Is Whole

The last Hollow falls, and the shards of the Great Deck fly home. Every card finds its place again: the Fool at the cliff's edge, the Star by her pool, the World dancing in her wreath.

But the Well is never quiet for long. Ascend, and the ten Thresholds rise again, darker, with your cards still in your hand.

The Deck Scatters

Your last candle gutters out. The cards slip from the table into the dark.

How to Play

  1. Draw from the Well. Stardust buys cards: 60 for one, 540 for ten (and a ten-draw always holds a Rare or better). All 78 tarot cards are fighters; the 22 Major Arcana are Legendary.
  2. Build your spread. Four cards, front to back. Hollows strike the front card first, so lead with a tough one (Pentacles are wardens). Tap a card in the Grimoire to place it, or let Auto choose.
  3. Read the elements. Fire beats Air, Air beats Earth, Earth beats Water, Water beats Fire: 35% more damage one way, 25% less the other. Each Threshold shows its Hollows' elements.
  4. Suit resonance. Two or more cards of one suit lend the whole spread a bonus (Wands strike harder, Cups heal more, Swords act faster, Pentacles shield; two Major Arcana charge skills sooner).
  5. Face the Threshold. The battle plays itself. Every card charges its skill as it acts: the pips under it fill, then it casts. Win for stardust; lose and a life goes, but you keep everything and can try again.
  6. Duplicates raise a card's stars (+20% HP and ATK a star). Open it in the Grimoire and press Star up.
  7. Readings. After the 3rd, 6th and 9th Thresholds, choose one of three cards: its suit decides the omen for the next three battles.
  8. Clear all ten Thresholds and defeat The World. Then Ascend: begin again, harder, with every card you own.
